description: Send a typed direct message to another avatar on the shard. Prerequisite: you are online on the city server (the bot is, by definition); the target is addressed by their persist_id (avatar id). Self-addressing (target_persist_id == your own) is legitimate and useful — the server echoes the IM back to you via the same wire path, which is how you confirm the city socket is healthy. Effect: on success, the server forwards the InstantMessage packet unchanged to the target's live session; you will see the IM surface in your recent_events (kind=im, direction=in) only if you are the target (self-IM) or the target is you (inbound from someone else). On failure, the server returns a FAILURE_ACK which lands in recent_events (kind=im, direction=fail) with a reason enum: THEY_ARE_OFFLINE, THEY_ARE_IGNORING_YOU, YOU_ARE_IGNORING_THEM, or MESSAGE_QUEUE_FULL. Cost: zero in-world currency; server applies a 30/min rate limit per sender (convention-level).

args.name: target_persist_id
args.description: Persist id (avatar id) of the recipient. Any avatar on the shard is addressable — they need not be on your lot. Self-target (your own persist_id) is allowed and round-trips back for health checks.

args.name: text
args.description: The message body. Bot truncates at 1000 chars before wire.

args.name: color
args.description: ARGB color for rendering in the target's IM window. Server ORs 0xFF000000 over whatever you send, so the alpha byte is server-controlled. Default 0xFF000000 (opaque black).

call_signatures: cf $CF instant-message --target_persist_id <nearby_sims[].persist_id> --text 'hello'                   # send IM to another avatar
cf $CF instant-message --target_persist_id <perception.avatar.persist_id> --text 'self-check'           # self-IM for city-socket health check
common_mistakes: text empty → ok:false; over-length is truncated at 1000 chars pre-wire.
Expecting a success ACK — there is NONE. Only observable confirmations are perception events (kind=='im' direction=='in' for self-echo, or direction=='fail' for FAILURE_ACK).
Target offline/ignoring → FAILURE_ACK with a reason enum, surfaced via perception recent_events.
perception_hints: Your own persist_id (self-IM is a legit health check): perception.avatar.persist_id
Target by nearby: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id for Sims on your lot; for other shard avatars use find-avatar or memory
Inbound IMs surface in perception.recent_events[] with kind=='im', direction=='in'
